title: Nodes Redraw Camera Ease
summary: One-shot Redraw nodes: preserve previous fixture camera on the layout patch so descriptor sync does not jump. After commit, useLayoutEffect runs a 1.8s RAF ease (first third hold, cubic blend) from current boardPlayPaneCamerasBaseline toward triptychCamerasFromFixture. Cancels nodes RAF when redraw play starts, when post-play override ease begins, and in shared cleanup paths. Effect deps omit baseline to avoid cleanup cancelling mid-ease.
